map.手算高阶行列式确实容易出错，通常用「初等行变换化成上三角、再取对角线乘积」的办法: Manual computation of a high-order determinant is indeed error-prone. The usual shortcut is elementary row operations to reach upper triangular form, then multiply the diagonal — far less work than expanding along a row. While doing it, remember that swapping two rows flips the sign, and multiplying a row by k multiplies the determinant by k. In engineering practice you hand this to a numeric library, but be aware that a determinant close to 0 may be nothing more than floating-point error.
